title: Indoor bike Z1 spin
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 30min steady on the trainer, HR 115-130, cap 132, cadence 85-95, light gear. Watch load target: icu 15, Garmin ~15-25.
GYM: none.
FUEL: none needed.
STOP RULE: HR above 132 for more than 2min, drop resistance. Do not extend past 30min.
WHY: aerobic top-up the day before the first threshold session (Tue 3x8min). It must not cost you Tuesday, so it stays truly easy.
